chats.answer:
If you're looking for the best microphone with both USB and XLR outputs, I'd prioritize sound quality, background-noise rejection, and the ability to upgrade to an audio interface later.

My top picks are the Shure MV7+, RØDE PodMic USB, and Samson Q9U. All three are dynamic microphones, making them particularly good for gaming, streaming, podcasting, voice calls, and recording in untreated rooms.

Best USB/XLR microphones in 2026

1. Shure MV7+ Podcast Microphone Black

Best overall
$255.00

Excellent voice quality, automatic gain adjustment, real-time denoising, touch mute, USB-C and XLR. Best for a premium, easy-to-use setup.

2. PodMic USB Dynamic Broadcast Microphone

Best value
$190.00

Rich broadcast-style sound, APHEX audio processing, USB-C and XLR. A particularly good choice if you don't need Shure's automatic features.

3. Samson Q9U XLR/USB Dynamic Broadcast Microphone - Black

Budget broadcast mic
$149.99

Dynamic microphone with USB-C and XLR, onboard controls, and a broadcast-style design. Good for podcasting and streaming on a tighter budget.

The MV7+ is also the top overall recommendation in MusicRadar's recent hands-on comparison.
